contact_quality_mean.Description: Mean of this sensor's EMOTIV contact-quality (CQ) channel over the released recording (CQ coded 0, 1, 2, 4; 4 = good contact). n/a for non-EEG channels. The full time course is in the corresponding CQ_ channel of the EDF.

eeg_quality_mean.Description: Mean of this sensor's EMOTIV EEG-quality (EQ) channel over the released recording (0-4; 4 = best). n/a for non-EEG channels. The full time course is in the corresponding EQ_ channel of the EDF.
